title: Cops Discover House of Horrors After Young Girl Escapes
description:
An Oklahoma husband and wife were arrested after a runaway child detailed disturbing abuse allegations from their household. Police in Piedmont, Oklahoma located a runaway child hiding under a blanket against a nearby building on March 15, 2024. When asked why they ran away the child described their foster mom as ‘scary’ saying she had been locked in a closet for days among other alarming allegations. Police searched the home and discovered a letter from one of the kids accusing the foster parent, identified as 43-year-old Tina Ramirez, of holding scissors to her neck, using a taser, and pepper spray, and even expressing concern that Ramirez would ‘kill’ them. Ramirez's husband Anthony Ibeziako, 26, also faces child neglect and abuse charges after allegedly failing to report the abuse. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
